stories.title: WhatsApp May Stop Working Without Registered SIM Under New Rules
stories.description: WhatsApp users may need to keep their registered SIM active, affecting secondary phones, tablets, and SIM-free devices.

stories.title: Critical Okta Access Gateway Flaw Lets Attackers With Admin Access Execute System Commands
stories.description: Okta patched a critical Access Gateway flaw allowing authenticated administrators to execute system commands via the Admin Console.

stories.title: HPE Warns Critical Aruba Networking Flaws Could Let Hackers Take Complete Control of Devices
stories.description: HPE patched multiple Aruba Networking flaws that could allow attackers to take full control of affected AOS-8 and AOS-10 devices

stories.title: Japanese Game Maker Capcom Has Confirmed – 11,774,247 Customer Records Exposed
stories.description: Capcom will notify customers after a breach exposed 11.77 million CAPCOM ID records, including email addresses and account activity.

stories.title: In Other News: Tor Exit Relays Hijacked, Banks Spot Rogue AI Agents, Self-Rebuilding macOS Ransomware
stories.description: Noteworthy stories that might have slipped under the radar: Russia’s APT28 hit NATO defense firms, PingCAP source code stolen, ShinyHunters negotiator probe.

stories.title: Hackers Breach Enterprise Firewalls and VPNs, Exposing Over 70,000 Credentials
stories.description: A campaign attributed to k0t exploits exposed network devices, establishes persistent access, and exfiltrates data using Rclone.

stories.title: Mirai Botnet Operators Join PHP2Shell Attacks as ASLR Bypass Exploits Emerge
stories.description: Researchers tie PHP2Shell attempts to a Mirai botnet and show an ASLR bypass, but no successful compromise has been confirmed yet.

stories.title: PHP Warns of Another Unpatched RCE Risk Two Days After Emergency PHP2Shell Patches
stories.description: PHP warns CVE-2026-115560 may enable code execution in unusual session setups and advises disabling session upload progress pending a routine fix.

stories.title: Russian-Linked Hackers Used New Mesh Network Backdoor in Destructive Ukraine Attack
stories.description: Sandworm wiped a Ukrainian logistics firm in September 2025 after UAC-0099 gained access and deployed a new Yggdrasil-based backdoor.

stories.title: China APT Uses AI Pentest Tool Artex in ConnectWise Attacks
stories.description: The state-sponsored hackers targeted hundreds of organizations and gained privileged access to some environments.
